description_en: Adds a face image template for face fusion by calling the AddFaceImageTemplate operation
description_zh: 本文介绍图像人脸融合模板增加AddFaceImageTemplate的语法及示例
name: AddFaceImageTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the face template image. We recommend that you use an China (Shanghai) region OSS URL. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Input limits:
Image format: JPG, JPEG, or PNG.
Image size: up to 20 MB.
Image resolution: at least 128 × 128 pixels and at most 2000 × 2000 pixels. The longest side must not exceed 2000 pixels.
The URL must not contain Chinese characters.
Multi-face images are supported. We recommend that the number of faces in the image does not exceed 5
parameters.help_zh:
人脸模板的图像地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
输入限制：
图像格式：JPG、JPEG、PNG。
图像大小：不超过20 MB。
图像分辨率：大于等于128×128像素，小于等于2000×2000像素，最长边小于等于2000像素。
URL地址中不能包含中文字符。
支持输入多人图像，建议图像中人脸个数不超过5个
parameters.name: image_url

FaceInfos.description_en:
The face IDs and position information returned when the input image contains multiple faces.

The FaceInfos parameter is returned only in multi-face scenarios
FaceInfos.description_zh:
用户输入图为多个人脸时，返回各人脸ID和位置信息。

只有在多人脸场景中，才会返回FaceInfos参数

items.description_en:

items.description_zh:

FaceRect.description_en: The position information of the face

Height.description_en: The height of the face bounding box

Width.description_en: The width of the face bounding box

X.description_en: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the face bounding box

Y.description_en: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the face bounding box

TemplateFaceID.description_en: The sub-template ID corresponding to the face
